title: orders.v1.OrderPlaced
description: A customer has committed to buy. This is the trigger for the fulfilment saga and the origin of every correlation_id in the system. Publishing it does NOT mean the order can be fulfilled — stock has not been checked and no money has moved. Consumers that treat OrderPlaced as a sale are wrong; wait for OrderConfirmed.

customer_email.description: Carried on the event so that notifications never has to call back into orders to send a confirmation. This is deliberate denormalisation: it trades a stale-email risk for the removal of a runtime dependency.

lines.description: At least one line. SKUs are unique within an order; duplicates are merged at the API boundary.

total_amount.description: Sum of quantity x unit_amount across all lines. Carried explicitly rather than left for consumers to compute, so that every service agrees on the figure and rounding happens exactly once.
